docker-compose.description: The catalog's compose files: one per template, hand-edited at blueprints/<id>/docker-compose.yml. If this pattern stops matching them, Renovate extracts zero catalog images and reports nothing, so the Dependency Dashboard's docker-compose section is the check that it still works.

postUpgradeTasks.description: Re-render after every bump, so the PR Renovate opens is complete. The per-template README, templates.json, catalog.json and index.html are generated from sources/ and the compose files; Renovate edits an input and cannot run make, so without this the generated artifacts can lag the input and render-idempotency fails the PR. build/render-ci.sh is the uv-optional entrypoint, because the Renovate container is not this repo's dev environment. Requires the runner to allow the command (RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS in catenahq/renovate).

packageRules.description: Renovate's docker datasource has release timestamps for Docker Hub only, so under the preset's 7-day minimumReleaseAge (timestamp-required) an image from any other registry never ages and is never bumped. The rules from here to the postgres rule look such images up through their upstream's GitHub releases instead: the same version numbers with real publish dates, so the cooldown still applies. A non-Docker-Hub image added to the catalog needs a rule here or it is never proposed. ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres and ghcr.io/nextcloud-releases/aio-talk have no semver tags and stay manual.
The image tags drop the v that the release tags carry.

Postgres is centrally governed: the per-template compose pins must equal postgres_default_image in sources/_meta.json (build/lint_postgres_pins.py fails the build otherwise). Group EVERY postgres bump -- the docker-compose pins AND the central-default customManager below -- into one reviewed PR so they move together and the lint stays green; a split bump (pins without the default, or vice versa) fails the lint. automerge off: a Postgres major/minor is a coordinated, reviewed change.

customManagers.description: Track the central Postgres image (postgres_default_image) in sources/_meta.json. The per-template compose pins follow it (enforced by build/lint_postgres_pins.py); the packageRule above groups this bump with the compose-pin bumps into one PR.
